paragraphs: The 740d xDrive is part of the current G70-generation 7 Series, introduced in 2022. It uses the B57 — a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel that's part of BMW's B-series engine family, known for its reliability and efficiency. The B57 is the same engine family used across BMW's modern diesel range, and it's a well-proven unit that continues to power the current 7 Series.
about.boldParagraph: The 740d xDrive is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
